description: UI Refinement - fix 7 verified frontend inconsistencies/gaps, refine (not replace) the existing Sandy+Coral design system, then a final cross-app visual QA pass.

userStories.title: Add a skip-to-content link
userStories.description: As a keyboard/screen-reader user, I want to skip the sidebar nav and jump straight to page content, so I don't have to tab through navigation on every page.
acceptanceCriteria: A visually-hidden-until-focused 'Skip to main content' link is the first focusable element in frontend/app/(app)/layout.tsx
The <main> element has id="main-content" and tabIndex={-1}
Activating the skip link moves keyboard focus to <main>
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (tab from page load, confirm skip link appears and works)

userStories.title: Delete the orphaned app/theme.css
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dead duplicate token definitions removed, so there's one source of truth for the design system.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm (grep across frontend/app and frontend/components) that nothing imports frontend/app/theme.css
Delete frontend/app/theme.css
globals.css remains the sole token source; visual output unchanged
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes

userStories.title: Add motion/duration design tokens
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want duration values defined once as tokens, so components stop hardcoding raw numerals.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --duration-fast: 100ms, --duration-base: 200ms, --duration-slow: 500ms to the @theme block in frontend/app/globals.css (values match what's already hardcoded, so nothing visually shifts)
Migrate frontend/components/ui/dialog.tsx and dropdown-menu.tsx (currently duration-100) to the new duration-fast token utility
Migrate frontend/components/vachan/AppSidebar.tsx (currently duration-200) to duration-base
Migrate frontend/components/vachan/FidelityRing.tsx (currently duration-500) to duration-slow
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (sidebar hover/active transitions and fidelity ring animation look unchanged)

userStories.title: Delete confirmed-orphaned components
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dead code removed, so the component directory reflects what's actually used.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-confirm zero importers (grep across frontend/app and frontend/components) for PersonaList.tsx, QuickActions.tsx, FidelityRingMini.tsx before deleting
Delete frontend/components/vachan/PersonaList.tsx, QuickActions.tsx, FidelityRingMini.tsx
cd frontend && npm run build passes (proves nothing referenced them)
cd frontend && npm run lint passes

userStories.title: Give /settings real content
userStories.description: As a user, I want the Settings page to show something useful instead of a placeholder, so it's not a dead end.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx uses the existing usePersonas hook to show a real persona summary list, using existing PersonaCard/EmptyState components
Includes a simple account/identity section using data already available client-side (no new backend endpoints)
Matches existing design tokens (sand/coral/ink) and the shared (app) layout
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Bring /channels into the shared layout and navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to reach the Channels page from the sidebar like every other page, and have it look consistent with the rest of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Move frontend/app/channels/page.tsx into the (app) route group (frontend/app/(app)/channels/page.tsx) so it inherits AppSidebar and the shared layout
Add a 'Channels' entry (with an appropriate lucide icon) to AppSidebar's NAV array in frontend/components/vachan/AppSidebar.tsx
Remove the page's own hand-rolled nav bar and its page.module.css file; restyle ChannelStatusGrid/export cards with existing Tailwind/shadcn classes (sand/coral/ink tokens) instead of CSS Modules
Existing content (channel list, export options) is preserved, only restyled and properly reachable
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill (Channels reachable from sidebar, visually consistent with Dashboard/Personas pages)

userStories.title: Tokenize FidelityRing's hardcoded gradient colors
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the fidelity ring's gradient built from design tokens, not magic hex strings, so the color system has one source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Add --color-coral-200: #F3C9A8 to the @theme block in globals.css, fitting the existing coral-300/400/500 scale
frontend/components/vachan/FidelityRing.tsx's SVG gradient stops reference the coral-200/coral-500 tokens instead of hardcoded hex literals
Visual appearance is pixel-identical before/after (same hex values, just tokenized)
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Final cross-app visual QA pass
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to confirm nothing regressed across the whole app after the above changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Walk through in browser: marketing home, marketing open-source page, dashboard, personas list + detail, conversations list + detail, mirror, settings, channels
Screenshot each page
Fix any real visual regression found during this pass (not hypothetical ones) — if none found, note that explicitly as a valid outcome
cd frontend && npm run build passes
cd frontend && npm run lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
